name: kv-tier-cold-page-read
hypothesis: A cold KvTierStore page fault (read + consume 21.77 MiB) fits one DSv4-Flash decode step (15.25 ms) on L2 host DRAM but not on L3 NVMe
result: L2 fault p50 2.31 ms (15% of budget); L3 fault p50 20.85 ms (137%)
finding: L2 read path is a 1us BTreeMap borrow; the fault cost is the host-side copy (18.9 GB/s). L3 read is IO-dominated (19.2 ms, 1.13 GB/s O_DIRECT) and exceeds the budget on its own.
decision: Per-page paging of active sequences from L3 killed; roadmap Goal 2 item 2 deleted. L2 path remains viable.
